data.body: [P2] Re-evaluate stop conditions before starting another callback round. This inner loop bypasses the history-only completion check below and the outer terminal-status check. Consequently, already-matched history-only tests still dispatch terminal follow-ups, while one callback can be contacted after another callback has completed an early-exit/racing execution, producing a spurious `CallbackError`. Check history-only completion between rounds and defer follow-ups after any terminal callback until execution status is checked. Add early-terminal and history-only regression tests.
